title: SDI quality capped by underlying 2D diffusion model
description: Score distillation is capped by the performance of the underlying 2D diffusion model and is prone to reproduce similar 'hallucinations' (e.g., text and limb anomalies). The algorithm inherits the biases of the 2D diffusion model and can produce skewed distributions.
